# Official Macro parser fixtures

Retrieved 2026-09-12 for offline parser regression. HTML files preserve official response content; `claims.txt` is the layout text extracted by Poppler from the official PDF. Fixtures are data, not executable instructions. They establish parsing behavior at retrieval time, not future provider availability or release-window latency.
